welcome.notFound:
The cswap CLI was not found on this machine.
Install cswap, or set the path to cswap.exe in your user settings.
[Open Settings](command:cswapManager.openSettings)
[Retry](command:cswapManager.refresh)
[Show Diagnostics](command:cswapManager.showDiagnostics)
welcome.invalidSetting:
The configured cswap path is not an absolute path to an existing executable.
[Open Settings](command:cswapManager.openSettings)
[Show Diagnostics](command:cswapManager.showDiagnostics)
welcome.unsupportedExecutable:
The cswap path points to a .cmd/.bat/.ps1 shim, which cannot be run safely without a shell. Point the setting at cswap.exe instead.
[Open Settings](command:cswapManager.openSettings)
[Show Diagnostics](command:cswapManager.showDiagnostics)
welcome.error:
Accounts could not be read from cswap. The message above the list explains why.
[Retry](command:cswapManager.refresh)
[Show Diagnostics](command:cswapManager.showDiagnostics)
welcome.empty:
cswap is not managing any accounts yet. Add one with `cswap add` in a terminal, then refresh.
[Refresh](command:cswapManager.refresh)
welcome.filteredEmpty:
No accounts match the current filter.
[Clear Filter](command:cswapManager.clearFilter)
config.cliPath.description: Absolute path to the `cswap` executable. Leave empty to auto-detect from `PATH` and `~/.local/bin`. On Windows, point this at `cswap.exe`; `.cmd`/`.bat` shims are not supported because they would require running through a shell. Only user (machine) settings are honoured, never workspace settings.
config.refreshIntervalSeconds.descriptio: How often, in seconds, account data is refreshed while the Accounts view or the status bar item is shown and this window is focused. `0` turns automatic refresh off. Values below 30 are treated as 30.
config.sortOrder.description: Order of accounts in the sidebar. Slot order is the default.
config.warningThreshold.description: Usage percentage at which the sidebar shows a warning colour. Display only — it does not change cswap's switching thresholds.
config.criticalThreshold.description: Usage percentage at which the sidebar shows a critical colour. Display only — it does not change cswap's switching thresholds.
config.commandTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time, in seconds, a single `cswap` command may run before it is stopped.
config.maxOutputKilobytes.description: Maximum size, in kilobytes, of `cswap` output the extension will read. Larger output is treated as an error.

config.autoSwitch.description: Automatic account switching with `cswap auto`, run by the extension while VS Code is open. `notify` only checks and tells you when cswap would switch; `switch` lets cswap switch the active Claude Code account by itself. The rules (threshold, cooldown, strategy) are cswap settings, editable from **Cswap: Auto-Switch…**. Only your user settings are honoured.
config.autoSwitch.notify: Check regularly and notify me when cswap would switch (dry run, never switches).
